Ingredients

4 medium carrots

400g spaghetti

3 large free-range eggs

150ml double cream

1 small handful of pecorino cheese

olive oil

4 rashers of smoked streaky bacon

½ a bunch of fresh flat-leaf parsley (15g)

optional: a pinch of chilli flakes

Method

  1. Bring a big pan of salted water to the boil.
  2. Peel the carrots into long ribbons with a speed peeler.
  3. Whisk the eggs, cream and most of the pecorino together in a bowl.
  4. Cook the spaghetti, adding the carrot ribbons for the last minute.
  5. Meanwhile, crisp the bacon in a little oil and chop the parsley.
  6. Drain the pasta, keeping a mugful of the water, and toss everything together off the heat, loosening with the water. Finish with the rest of the cheese and the chilli, if using.
